ability.name: Machine Context Check
ability.description: Perform Step 0 machine context check dynamically determining the current platform, local adapters, and privileges.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $id = whoami /all; $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem; $dom = $cs.PartOfDomain; $dn = $cs.Domain; $os = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem).Caption; $hn = $env:COMPUTERNAME; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $hn"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $dom"; Write-Output "DOMAIN: $dn"; Write-Output "OS: $os"; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI ---"; $id } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step0.txt

rationale: Step 0 is critical to determine domain membership and identify multi-homed adapters silently.
